plugins.description: Paste your course units and get a language expert per unit (18 of them, from Java and SQL to Haskell, Assembly, VHDL and maths); lessons, spaced review, code/process/idea/report feedback, exam-season plans, mock oral defences and exams — without doing graded work for you.
